channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Goga Bitadze | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Goga Bitadze from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Robert Horry, Goga Bitadze
item.description:
Draymond Green on the Luka vs Goga beef:

“Goga Bitadze said he would fu*k his whole family up. At some point I can’t stand for that, I got to stand up for myself. Robert Horry goes on the show and brings me up in the conversation. Maybe I think he wanted some attention. So, everybody let’s get give him the attention he deserves. But I don’t know what I had to do with this.”

Draymond Green on Robert Horry, Goga Bitadze, Mar 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kristaps Porzingis on Goga Bitadze
item.description:
Kristaps Porzingis on playing to a fired up TD Garden crowd after getting bloodied by an inadvertent elbow to the forehead from Goga Bitadze:

“I love my WWE moments for sure. It just happens…I always love engaging with the crowd…It was cool, it was fun.”

Kristaps Porzingis on Goga Bitadze, Apr 24, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Nate Bjorkgren on Goga Bitadze
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Bjorkgren on losing Bitadze's status:

“He's moving a little bit more every day. I'm not sure on the time frame when he'll be back yet. I wouldn't think too much longer.”

Nate Bjorkgren on Goga Bitadze, Jan 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Goga Bitadze
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:McMillan on Bitadze (knee), who hasn't practiced fully since getting to Orlando:

“I don't expect him to be doing anything for at least the next couple of days.”

Nate McMillan on Goga Bitadze, Jul 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.
